content: For SaaS with 100s-1000s of tenants, shared-schema with a tenant_id column plus Postgres Row-Level Security (RLS) is the modern default: operationally simple (single schema/migration set), scales well, and RLS provides a DB-enforced isolation guarantee (via SET LOCAL app.current_tenant per transaction) rather than relying solely on application-layer WHERE clauses. Schema-per-tenant does not scale past a few hundred tenants due to catalog bloat and migration fan-out. Database-per-tenant is for high-compliance/low-tenant-count scenarios, not applicable here.
